briefdescription.para: Set the file type to be emitted (assembly or object code).

detaileddescription.para: When set, the linkage of globals will be restored prior to code generation. That is, a global symbol that had external linkage prior to LTO will be emitted with external linkage again; and a local will remain local. Note that this option only affects the end result - globals may still be internalized in the process of LTO and may be modified and/or deleted where legal.
The default behavior will internalize globals (unless on the preserve list) and, if parallel code generation is enabled, will externalize all locals.

briefdescription.para: Pass options to the driver and optimization passes.

detaileddescription.para: These options are not necessarily for debugging purpose (the function name is misleading). This function should be called before LTOCodeGenerator::compilexxx(), and LTOCodeGenerator::writeMergedModules().

briefdescription.para: Parse the options set in setCodeGenDebugOptions.

detaileddescription.para: Like setCodeGenDebugOptions(), this must be called before LTOCodeGenerator::compilexxx() and LTOCodeGenerator::writeMergedModules().

briefdescription.para: Write the merged module to the file specified by the given path.
Compile the merged module into a single output file; the path to output file is returned to the caller via argument "name".

simplesect.para: It is up to the linker to remove the intermediate output file. Do not try to remove the object file in LTOCodeGenerator's destructor as we don't who (LTOCodeGenerator or the output file) will last longer.

briefdescription.para: As with compile_to_file(), this function compiles the merged module into single output file.

detaileddescription.para: Instead of returning the output file path to the caller (linker), it brings the output to a buffer, and returns the buffer to the caller. This function should delete the intermediate file once its content is brought to memory. Return NULL if the compilation was not successful.
Optimize merged modules using various IPO passes.

briefdescription.para: Compiles the merged optimized module into a single output file.

detaileddescription.para: It brings the output to a buffer, and returns the buffer to the caller. Return NULL if the compilation was not successful.

briefdescription.para: Compile the merged optimized module ParallelismLevel output files each representing a linkable partition of the module.

detaileddescription.para: If out contains more than one element, code generation is done in parallel with ParallelismLevel threads. Output files will be written to the streams created using the AddStream callback. Returns true on success.

briefdescription.para: Enable the Freestanding mode: indicate that the optimizer should not assume builtins are present on the target.
Verify the merged module on first call.

detaileddescription.para: Sets HasVerifiedInput on first call and doesn't run again on the same input.

briefdescription.para: Restore original linkage for symbols that may have been internalized.
